source.text: The limit minus the closed-form centre temperature: 1150 C = 1423.15 K minus 784.2876 K. The cladding runs at 318.7 K, below 500 C, so the 1150 C rule is the one in force and the 950 C rule has no margin. A margin is not an integrity assessment: FEED computes no stress.
source.check: Second method: the same peak entry's cross-checks (the SAR's own equation 9 for the steady case; oracles/transient-case-reference.py for the pulse); the margin is that peak subtracted from the limit, and FEED's limit check reports the same number through the real solver (docs/temperature-limits.md).
